title: How Chandrayaan-3 Landed on the Moon
summary: Follow India's Moon mission from lunar orbit to a gentle landing, then find out what its rover measured.
notes: Source: ISRO mission timeline and equipment, https://www.isro.gov.in/Chandrayaan3.html and https://www.isro.gov.in/Chandrayaan3_Details.html

steps.title: Meet the three travellers
sentences: Chandrayaan-3 had three main parts: a propulsion module, the Vikram lander and the Pragyan rover.
The propulsion module helped carry Vikram and Pragyan to an orbit around the Moon.
When Vikram separated and began its descent, the rover was still riding inside.
points: Propulsion module: carries the lander to lunar orbit
Lander: brings the rover to the surface
Rover: drives and studies the surface

steps.title: How to land gently
sentences: A soft landing means setting down slowly enough that the vehicle can work afterward.
There is almost no air on the Moon, so a parachute cannot slow a lander the way it does on Earth.
Vikram used rocket engines to reduce its speed and instruments to help it find a safe landing area.
points: Rocket thrust helps the lander brake
Instruments help it avoid hazardous ground

steps.title: A new place to explore
sentences: Vikram landed on 23 August 2023 in the Moon's southern high latitudes. The landing site lies in the south polar region, some distance from the pole itself.
A ramp unfolded and Pragyan rolled onto the soil.
The rover carried instruments that could identify elements in the lunar surface material.
points: Vikram landed safely in the lunar south polar region
Pragyan rolled down a ramp and measured the soil

steps.title: Try a mission decision
sentences: Pretend you are choosing where to land. One patch is flat and smooth, while another is full of rocks and steep slopes.
A flat area makes it easier for the lander's legs to touch down evenly and for the rover to roll away.
The mission showed why finding a safe spot is as important as slowing down.
points: Choose level ground with few hazards
Think ahead to the rover's first drive

facts: Pragyan travelled about 101 metres around the landing site, according to ISRO.
One instrument on Vikram measured temperatures at different depths in the lunar soil.

quiz.q: What slowed Vikram near the Moon's surface?
quiz.why: The Moon has almost no air for a parachute. Rocket engines can slow the craft even in a vacuum.

quiz.q: Which part drove around and studied the soil?
quiz.why: Pragyan was the wheeled rover. Vikram was the lander it rolled out of.

quiz.q: Which landing site would you choose if both were equally easy to reach?
quiz.why: Flat ground helps the lander stay upright and gives the rover a clear path.
